purpose: Continue robot development beyond the preserved submission baseline: measured workspace coverage and corrective actions driven by current RGB images.
baseline: models/dinner_suite/suite.json plus original models/bottle_visual and models/bottle_relays; keep all baseline weights and failure evidence unchanged
object_scope: One upright amber bottle, known shape, yaw in [-0.6,0.6] rad. Other objects remain obstacles. No sideways, liquid or other-object claim in this stage.

workspace_gate.interpretation: Approach feasibility only. Solver failure is not proof of physical unreachability. Preserve rejected and collision cases. Full manipulation needs separate physical trials.

representation_gaps: Baseline actions are functions of an initial centroid and internal progress; new image observations generally cannot alter grasp/carry actions.
One overhead centroid is ambiguous under occlusion and object height changes.
Current per-skill trajectories encode narrow start regions and fixed goals; arbitrary target positions are not action inputs.
stages: A: Measure approach feasibility across all 48 grid/arm pairs. Probe multiple fixed RGB views throughout exposed real bottle traces; record valid, missing and ambiguous detections separately.
B: Build an explicit live-RGB pose observer and a neural action model with measured joint state and requested target inputs. Keep semantic task sequencing and the separate physical monitor disclosed.

C: Collect at most 32 varied training episodes including recovery attempts; independently replay any saved action labels. Disturbance magnitude/timing and simulator object poses are training/scoring data, never inference inputs.

D: Train a bounded candidate on the RTX 4070; report actual training time and peak VRAM. Test development placements, freeze selection, then compare live-image versus frozen-image control on every declared unseen placement/disturbance case.
destination_selection: index (scene_seed modulo 3); z from observed table calibration
disturbance_design: Declare a separate physical-push specification after exposed calibration verifies a 5-15 mm recoverable translation without tipping. Use forces at a disclosed contact-equivalent application point, no teleportation. Freeze that specification before development or evaluation comparisons.
evaluation_requirements: No relaxed collision, contact, release, parking or placement thresholds.
Publish all attempted cases and explicit refusals, including unreachable/ambiguous observations.
Record identical-observation action counterfactuals with live versus frozen images; mere image capture or frame refresh is not evidence of useful correction.
Paired physical trials must show better correction success with live images before claiming a visual-feedback benefit.
A finite suite demonstrates measured coverage only, never every reachable placement.
active_now: Stage A feasibility and RGB observability diagnostics. Stages B-D depend on measured findings, not yet verified capabilities.
